Hands-Off • Prevention & De-Escalation

Who this program is for

Healthcare, education, behavioral health, human services, corporate, and community teams.

A hands-off program focused on prevention, assessment, communication, and recovery.

Learning outcomes

  • Recognize behavioral triggers and early warning signs.
  • Use verbal and nonverbal communication to reduce tension.
  • Apply trauma-informed approaches while preserving dignity.
  • Coordinate a hands-off response and support post-incident learning.
Plan your training

Format & completion

8-hour comprehensive program

Awareness: 2 hours; basic: 4 hours; comprehensive: 8 hours. Instructor development: 16–24 hours (20-hour planning midpoint). Final format is confirmed with DACI.

DACI Certificate of Completion following successful program completion.

Inside the program

Curriculum & Learning Modules

A practical overview of the topics covered in this DACI program.

MODULE 01

Understanding human behavior

Explore stress, fear, behavioral triggers, and the influence of trauma.

MODULE 02

Dynamic assessment

Notice warning signs, environmental factors, and changes in risk.

MODULE 03

Communication for de-escalation

Practice listening, empathy, rapport, and calm verbal and nonverbal communication.

MODULE 04

Trauma-informed crisis response

Build trust and preserve dignity during difficult interactions.

MODULE 05

Personal safety & situational awareness

Consider personal space, environmental positioning, and routes to support.

MODULE 06

Hands-off crisis intervention

Practice decision-making, de-escalation, and team communication.

MODULE 07

Managing challenging situations

Recognize threatening behavior and know when to seek additional help.

MODULE 08

Recovery, documentation & follow-up

Review incidents, support recovery, and identify prevention opportunities.
